desc:
🐉 Steal a Dragon Egg

Explore a world filled with mysterious dragon eggs!

🥚 Venture into different zones and discover dragon eggs.
🏃 Escape dangerous guardians while carrying your discoveries.
🐲 Hatch eggs to reveal unique fantasy creatures.
🏡 Grow your collection and build your own dragon sanctuary.
✨ Discover rare mutations and expand your collection.

How many dragons can you discover?
